assignments.rationale: This occurrence defines the concept of vector length in grade 10. It is the same core mathematical concept as the grade 12 concept occurrence.

This occurrence defines the concept of vector length in grade 12. The description is identical to the grade 10 concept. Grade differences are not a reason to split, so it should be merged with the grade 10 concept.

This occurrence is a FORMULA providing the coordinate expression for calculating vector length in 3D space (Oxyz). It is a specific formula derived from the general concept. A CONCEPT and a FORMULA should normally remain separate if one is the mathematical object and the other is a formula describing it. Therefore, it should be split into a separate canonical node for the formula.
